text:
B: Bethany! Hello, love! I was hoping I get you. I'm Danuta.
A: Hiya. Yeah, I saw your photo. I'm glad it's you, actually.
B: Oh, thank you! I thought I finish already, and then, one more. So, you are the one with the dog, yes? Lauren told me, and the flowers.
A: Yeah, Mabel. She's there, look. Just her ears.
B: Ah, so sweet. Are you alright, love? You look a bit tired.
A: Erm, I'm alright. I get a bit nervous with things like this, so I'm sort of... worn out now. Sorry.
B: Don't be sorry. Five calls with strangers, of course you are tired. Me too, my face hurts from smiling. Have you had your tea?
A: Not yet. Sausage and mash. I keep saying it, so I have to make it now.
B: Good, simple, perfect. Where are you, Pontefract? Lauren said Yorkshire.
A: Yeah, Pontefract. You're Preston?
B: Preston, yes, but from Poland. I clean at the hospital, on the wards. Eleven years.
A: Oh, that must be hard. Do you like it?
B: I love it. The patients, the nurses. Some old ladies have nobody, so I talk while I mop. Sometimes this is the only talk they have all day, you know?
A: That's lovely. I used to do the sympathy flowers at the shop. People would come in crying and I'd just sort of let them talk. I didn't mind it. I think I was better at that than the actual... the money and orders.
B: This is a gift, Bethany. Not everybody can sit with sad people. Most people run away.
A: Thank you. I don't know. Since the shop closed I sort of lost my confidence. I get really anxious, like phoning places for jobs. I've been meaning to go to the doctor about it, but I keep putting it off.
B: Go. Really, love, go. I am the same with my blood pressure, I put off, put off, then my husband takes me himself. The doctors are nice, they hear this every day.
A: Yeah. Maybe I'll ring next week. Or get my mum to.
B: Your mum is close?
A: Ten minutes. We go for Sunday dinner most weeks. She does proper Yorkshire puddings.
B: Ah, Yorkshire puddings, I tried to make one time. Flat like pancakes. My son laughed so much.
A: Ha. The trick's having the oil really hot. My banana bread sank yesterday, so I'm not one to talk.
B: Sunk cake is still cake! Lauren told me she is going to make you sell your pressed flowers.
A: Everyone's said it today. Callum said put them on Etsy.
B: Then maybe everyone is right, no? Start small. One for me. I pay you. For my kitchen, near the geraniums.
A: Oh, you don't have to pay. I could just send—
B: No! I pay. This is your first customer. Is how it starts, you—
